build.beforeDevCommand: npm run prepare:browser-host && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run prepare:browser-host && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
